title: Nothing reachable only by listening
statement: Make every page work with narration off: whatever the narration says or reveals must also be reachable by the learner's own tap or a transcript, never only by listening.
detail: Read-aloud is a choice a grade 3 reading course offers on every page, so every page has to work both ways. A review of the read-it-myself mode found that a page staged on narration marks alone dead-ended: the marks never arrived, so the example, the non-example and the gate below them never appeared, and the page's Next stayed locked. The build now reaches each stage by whichever comes first, the voice or the tap, but by convention rather than a validator, so a new staged page type has to opt in (`grade3-reading/course-renderer/docs/rules/audio-and-voiceover.md`, lines 228-232).

evidence.quote: Anything a page reveals as the narration reaches it must also be reachable by the child's own tap. A page that stages itself on marks alone dead ends for whoever chose "I'll read it myself": the marks never arrive, so the example, the non-example and the gate below them never appear, and the page's own Next stays locked on a gate the child was never shown.
with narration off the paragraph is simply shown, since nothing may be reachable only by listening.
